messages:
mia: emergency cuteness interrupt  meet Cecil, the parrot who thinks my lunch is a communal suggestion. pic: https://i.imgur.com/CecilPerch.jpg :parrot:
rafael: that eyebrow tilt is pure negotiation. what did he steal first? :joy:
mia: sandwich, obviously. also my shoelace (for reasons), and my will to say no. video of the sandwich snatch incoming.
jun: sandwich snatch clip was art. caption: \"When you ordered a salad but destiny says otherwise.\" :salad:
erin: does Cecil give kisses? asking for a friend.
sam: fun fact: parrots are very social. also will learn to mimic the office printer if allowed. i vote yes for printer-mimic demo.
mia: training note: he only mimics people who offer him a cracker. bribe required.
ops-bot: reminder: please confirm all attendees are okay with birds in shared spaces and keep windows closed near aviary guests. :information_source:
rafael: poll: should we schedule a 15-min \"Cecil cameo\" slot during next week's lunch? reply yes/no
jun: yes, remote cam mandatory. i need to see the sandwich heist in HD.
erin: yes. i will bring earplugs for the squawkers (kidding, maybe).
sam: no unless someone can teach him to fetch tiny whiteboards.
mia: tiny code note for diet (per avian vet):
```
allowed: fruits, veggies, bird-safe crackers
forbidden: chocolate, avocado, caffeine
```

mia: PSA: keep all open drinks away from the perch. he is curious and also very aerodynamic.
rafael: uploaded slo-mo: Cecil executing a perfect swoop-to-toast maneuver. also made a meme: \"We had a meeting about snacks. Cecil had a meeting about snacks.\"
jun: remote-friendly idea: set up a little livestream and let folks vote on \"Best Parrot Trick.\" winner gets a digital badge.
erin: also request: can someone bring a tiny cape? superhero parrot is a branding opportunity.
ops-bot: noted reactions recorded :heart: :laughing:. Please ensure compliance with pet policy and allergy checks before bringing Cecil into common areas.
mia: final pic: Cecil guarding the crumbs like a tiny feathery security guard. closing line: \"Do not approach the sandwich. Leave offering at 3ft.\" pic: https://i.imgur.com/CecilGuard.jpg :sweat_smile:
